content: Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr un'syääl a mfum a aŋità a Lɔmà
Ungö mutɛn a baar ndaa yanswà kàkwen nde mutɛn, Yɛsu kàkyen Kapɛrnawum.
Un'tsüüŋ a kaptɛn mwɛy aŋità a Lɔmà kàfakweenà nde mbɔɔn kàkäl anà ukyal, tsütsü mukwà.
Mpal kàwem nde làsaŋ a Yɛsu, nde kàtöm abyääl a Ayudà ntɔn ba bàkun'bɔɔn naa nde uyàkɔɔr un'tsüüŋ ande.
Ba waa bàyi akà Yɛsu, bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n, waa bàtɛn naa: « Mbuur wà kan'kwo muwal bweel aŋàkwo,
ntɔn nde afàkwen nsi abi, nde sye kàtöŋ ndwà a nköŋ abi a ngim ande ŋakwo. »

Yɛsu kàkyen anà ba. Mpal kàkäl nde tsütsü a ndwà a mbuur awun, mbuur wa kàtɔ̈m asam ande ntɔn mutɛn naa: « Mwol, twon an'pà ndür ngye mpay. Mɛ in'wà mbuur a man'be, mɛ in'kwe anki muwal ngye u ndwà amɛ.
Lalan mpa in'yi mɛ, mɛ ŋakwo. Tɛn ngɔk mwɛy ntɔn un'tsüüŋ amɛ ukɔɔrà.

Ntɔn mɛ ŋakwo in'wà mfum u ngyɛl, wɛɛ mɛ in'we anà aŋità in'fàler mɛ, mɛ in'sàtɛn a umwɛy naa: "Kyen", laa ukyà nde. Mɛ in'sàtɛn a wàsin naa: "Yà", laa uyà nde. Mɛ in'sàtɛn a un'tsüüŋ amɛ naa: "Kyer abà", laa ukyer nde. »
Mpal kàwem Yɛsu ndaa ayi, nde kàkyey kaptɛn awà, waa ubulà, uler baar banswà bàyun'labà, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ, mɛ alàkyään, itàkal kà Isàlɛl mɛ ŋàtàman anki làkwikilà a mbɔɔn abà. »
Baar kàtöm kaptɛn, bàfurà ba ndwà ande, ba bàmɛn un'tsüüŋ ande wàŋàkɔɔrà.
Yɛsu kan'wiy mwan a un'kweel a un'dim mwɛy
Yàkäl naa ilä kyàlääb pa, Yɛsu kàkyen bul mwey ikɔb a la Nayin. Alɔŋki ande anà un'sɛŋ a baar bàkäl mukyà anà nde.
Mpal kàkäl nde tsütsü a bul alan, iköŋ a baar kyàkäl mukàdyee ndom, mwan baal mwɛy mpɛl wà un'kweel a un'dim mwɛy. Baar a bul alan mbɔɔn bàkäl anà nde.
Mpal kun'mɛn Mwol, ngyɛb yàkyer un'käär, waa kun'kyään naa: « Twon an'lel! »
Nde kàsin tsütsü a un'böl, waa kàbä wa. Baar bàyisyeenà wa laa bàmbär ba. Nde waa kàtɛn naa: « Mwan baal, mɛ amaswaŋ, wiyà! »
Ndom waa ubwaay, waa usɛmà muyäm. Yɛsu waa kun'fuur akà ngwän.
Baar banswà bàkäl u bɔɔmà anà musyäŋà Nzam, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Ŋangɔɔm a kölàköl kan'too uboo a bi, Nzam kan'yàbay baar ande. »
Làsaŋ a Yɛsu alà làkyer apää u Yuday lanswà anà kà an'bul a tsütsü manswà.
Akyeey a Ywan Un'düümà
Alɔŋki a Ywan bàkyer un'kyäänà ndaa ayi.
Nde kàbel abɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a ba, waa katöm akà Mwol ntɔn ba bun'fuul naa: « Nkye ngye awà Klistɔ awà ayàyà, lɛɛ bi ikyer adil wàsin? »
Mpal bàkɔlà ba apà Yɛsu, ba bàtɛn a nde naa: « Ywan Un'düümà kàmitɔm akà ngye ntɔn muyöb naa nkye ngye awà mbuur awayàyà, lɛɛ bi ikyer adil wàsin? »
Taaŋ nsil alan, Yɛsu waa ukɔɔr baar a an'kyal mbɔɔn, baar bàkäl anà an'too anà baar bàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be, waa uduub mii a ikwàmii mbɔɔn.

Nde kafuur abà: « Kàlun'kyään Ywan ndaa yanswà lan'man anà lan'wem bɛ: Ikwàmii bàmuman, ikar bàmumbarà, baar a ukyal a bay bàmupɔŋà, ikwan'tsü bàmuwem, ndom yàmuwiyà, ndaa a Nzam bàmulɔŋ akà aŋàlàmbwà.
Un'sak akà mbuur mpa asàpiy làkwikilà ande amu mɛ. »
Ungö a nkyeen a alɔŋki a Ywan, Yɛsu kàsɛmà mutà imbäl a Ywan: « Bɛ ininà làkàler u nsye a ipɔl? Kite a iful kànini un'pöb?
Wɛɛ bɛ ininà làkàler? Mbuur kàbwäärà a ntwɛn? Làler, baar bàfàbwaar ipfɛy a ntal anà bàfàkal unsà un'naaŋ, bàfàkal uboo a ndwà a amfum.
Bɛ ininà làkàler? Ŋangɔɔm mwɛy? Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, nde kan'söön ŋangɔɔm.
Nde wà mbuur awà bàsön naa:

content.text: "Le, mɛ an'tɔm un'kyeey amɛ kusà angye,
ntɔn muyilà mbwo angye kusà a ngye."

content: « Mɛ alàkyään naa uboo a baar banswà kàbör un'kaar, akà umwɛy kàmusöön watɛy. Wɛɛ kimbuur ikikye uboo a Imwol a Nzam kàmun'söön. »
Baar banswà bàweemà ndaa ande, itàkal afüür a itɛr, bàkyer akyey naa Nzam wà balàbal, lalan bàkyeenà ba mukàwal ndüümà a Ywan.
Wɛɛ amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn bàtön ndaa kàkwen Nzam ntɔn ba anà ndüümà a Ywan.
Yɛsu kàfàtɛn naa: « Mɛ baar a taaŋ alà an'kwo mukasi anà nà? Ba bà asànaa bànà?
Ba bà asànaa baan bàfàmbàmbar u balàbal anà bàfàtɛn ba a ba naa: Bi kàlabɛɛrà mfuŋ, wɛɛ bɛ làkyen anki, bi kàlàtɔ̈ɔ̈l an'diim a ilel, wɛɛ bɛ làlel anki.
Ntɔn Ywan Un'düümà kàkyer ayà, kàdyee anki nsɔ, kànwee anki man, wɛɛ bɛ làtɛɛnà naa: Nde we anà dweelà a làbe.
Mwan a mbuur kan'yà, akyer adyà, akyer anwà, wɛɛ bɛ làtɛn naa: "Awà wà ndyeel anà un'nweel a man, un'sam a afüür a itɛr anà baar a man'be."
Wɛɛ an'yeerà a Nzam, baar bàfàman naa ma màbalàbal bà baar bàfàkyey ma. »
Yɛsu u ndwà a umfarisi Simɔn
Yàmɛnà naa umfarisi mwɛy kàbel Yɛsu mukàdyà u ndwà ande. Yɛsu kàbilà nde u ndwà a mbuur awun, waa kàsɛmà mudyà u mɛsà.
U bul alan kàkäl anà un'kaar a pasàsɛ mwɛy. Mpal kàwem nde naa Yɛsu wàmudyà u ndwà a mbuur awun, nde kàyàbilà anà làbuuŋ a pɛɛl làŋàyɔl a may a usɔŋ,
nde kàbü ungö a Yɛsu kà in'kɔl ande. Nde kàkäl mulel, nsaaŋ ande yàbwee kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kàkɔɔmà ya a ntswe ande, kàndüürà mya, waa kàkiirà mya may a usɔŋ.

Un'mfarisi awà kàbel Yɛsu u ndwà ande kàmɛn nde abun, laa kàyweerà nde u mpem naa: « Mbuur wà ulàkal ŋangɔɔm a ndandaa, nde akyer alàyöb naa un'kaar awà wà nà, nde akyer alàyöb naa nde wà un'kaar a pasàsɛ. »
Yɛsu kun'fuur u ndaa a dudu naa: « Simɔn, mɛ in'we anà kindaa muyäm anà ngye. » Nde kàfuur naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, yäm. »
Yɛsu naa: « Ilä mwɛy un'pɛɛl a nkul mwɛy kàkäl anà asɔ̈ɔ̈m abɔ̈ɔ̈l. Wàtàtwɛb kàlun'fuur an'falà nkam tyeen, wàyweel an'falà an'kwem an'tyeen.
Baar abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkäl anki anà ngim mukun'fuur. Nde waa kadwääl nkul. Uboo a baar abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, nà ayun'kwen aŋàsöön? »
Simɔn kun'fuur naa: « Mɛ in'kasii naa mbuur awà kàdwääl nde nkul a mbɔɔn. » Yɛsu naa: « An'man, ngye an'yweer ubwaŋ. »

Ungö apan, Yɛsu waa uler un'kaar awun, waa utɛn a Simɔn naa: « Ngye akyun'manà un'kaar wà? In'bilà mɛ u ndwà angye, ngye an'dà an'pɛ anki muywɛy in'kɔl, wɛɛ nde, nde mya kan'ywɛy a nsaaŋ ande anà kan'kɔɔm mya a ntswe ande.
Ngye mɛ andüür anki, wɛɛ nde, sɛmà in'bilà mɛ nde uyɔ̈n anki mundüür in'kɔl amɛ.
Ngye mɛ may a usɔŋ an'tsüül anki kun'tswe, wɛɛ nde, nde kan'tsuul may a usɔŋ kà in'kɔl amɛ.
Lalan mɛ akyään naa bàkyun'dwääl nkul a man'be ande manswà, ntɔn nde kan'kwen mbɔɔn. Wɛɛ mbuur akwà bàmun'dwääl nkul a man'be ikikye, nde akwen sye ikikye. »
Waa nde kàtɛn a un'kaar awun naa: « Mɛ amadwääl nkul a man'be angye. »
Baar bumwɛy bàkäl anà nde bàtɛɛnà u mpem naa: « Mbuur awà wà nà, nde mudwääl baar nkul a man'be aba? »
Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn a un'kaar awun naa: « Làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈, kyen unsà duu. »
